outputFormat.description: The container/encoding of the output. `mp4` (default) returns an H.264 .mp4. `prores` returns a ProRes .mov. `png_sequence` returns a .zip of PNG frames. `sdr_rec709_10bit` returns a 10-bit Rec.709 HEVC .mp4 for SDR grading pipelines. Non-mp4 formats incur an additional surcharge: 5 credits per second for `prores` and `png_sequence`, and 20 credits per second for `sdr_rec709_10bit` — 40 credits per second when the output is larger than 4 megapixels — includes anything larger than 1440p, up through 4K.

proresProfile.description: The ProRes profile to use. Only valid when `outputFormat` is `prores`. Defaults to `4444`. Note: generated content contains no transparency — the alpha channel in `4444` / `4444 XQ` outputs is present but fully opaque; choose these tiers for 12-bit 4:4:4 color fidelity, not for mattes.
